query:
SELECT 
                s.id as "id: SiteId", 
                s.user_id as "user_id: UserId", 
                s.url as "url: SiteUrl", 
                s.created_at, 
                s.last_check, 
                s.status as "status: SiteStatus", 
                s.status_updated_at,
                s.active,
                p.extra
            FROM sites s
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT extra
                FROM site_pings
                WHERE site_id = s.id
                ORDER BY time DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ) p ON true
            WHERE s.user_id = $1
            ORDER BY s.id
